result.response:
I have resolved the issue and extracted all records:

1. **Root Cause & Fix**: Inspection of the header bytes in [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-3vxdkzmd/main.db-wal) (`753d44c0...` instead of the SQLite WAL magic `377f0682`) showed that the entire WAL file had been XOR-encoded with `0x42`. Decrypting the WAL file by XORing every byte with `0x42` restored the valid WAL header and all 4 frames, allowing SQLite to read and checkpoint the WAL cleanly into [main.db](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-3vxdkzmd/main.db).
2. **Data Extraction**: All 11 records (including the 6 added records and the updated values for records 1 and 2 from the WAL frames) have been extracted, sorted by `id`, and saved to [recovered.json](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-3vxdkzmd/recovered.json).
